cohort: 394 pregnant women referred to the prenatal care clinic at the Al- Zahra Hospital, affiliated to Guilan University of Medical Sciences, Iran
finding: Depression during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of preeclampsia, premature membrane rupture, preterm delivery, cesarean section, intrauterine fetal death, intrauterine fetal growth restriction, and lower birth weight.
birth_weight: Lower in infants of mothers with depression during pregnancy
